designer_intent.focus: Create an aggressive West Coast instrumental hip-hop arrangement emphasizing sampled texture beds and dynamic one-shot hits with club energy.

presetor_intent.style: West Coast Hip-Hop sample slicing and layering with aggressive sonic character

sensei_drum.brief: Design drum parts emphasizing sample slice techniques for texture beds and sharp one-shot hits for rhythmic accents.

bass_generator.brief: Generate bass lines complementary to drum patterns maintaining club energy, using sample-based or synthesized bass timbres.

harmony_generator.brief: Provide chordal textures with sample layering to support aggressive mood without melodic complexity.

melody_generator.brief: Add minimal melodic accents using sparse and impactful one-shot samples, avoiding continuous melodies.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement structure ensuring energy curve matches aggressive club style and sample slicing techniques are well integrated.

presetor.brief: Apply preset configurations emphasizing slice-based sample channels and processing for a tight, club-oriented sonic palette.

songgps.brief: Track and optimize arrangement sections ensuring smooth transitions and maintaining desired energy profile.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix with clean channel routing without processing to allow flexible post-processing on sliced and one-shot samples.
